Hi team —

I reviewed the customer's tracked DPA and summarized follow-ups below. I also attached an internal redline (Redwood_DPA_v3_redline.pdf) that highlights where LumenCare's suggested carve would materially change our risk profile.

Summary of key points and proposed responses:
1) SCCs: Redwood will adopt the EU 2024 SCCs. We'll include an SCC Annex as an exhibit to the DPA. No change to commercial terms required.

2) Hosting carve (customer asks for EU-only residency):
   - Proposal A (preferred): For the pilot, Redwood will commit to EU-hosted primary and warm-standby nodes. Add an explicit Order Form clause: "Production workload and primary store shall be hosted in the EU region specified in the Order Form."
   - Limitation: We cannot guarantee failover will remain in-region in an operational emergency without a separate runbook and approval process. We'll offer a runbook commitment and a notification SLA.
   - If LumenCare insists on contractually binding full geofencing for all failover scenarios, we need an exception to be approved by Security + Infra and will likely require an additional fee.

3) Subprocessor list and notice: Monica will supply the current subprocessor inventory and our 30-day notice process. We'll provide a one-off review window for major subprocessor additions for a 12-month period post-execution.

4) Evidence requests (SOC2, KMS, export procedures):
   - SOC 2 Type II: available; we can provide a redacted report under NDA.
   - Encryption: KMS detail (we use cloud KMS with customer key support for Dedicated/Private; hosted customers use Redwood-managed keys) — Monica to provide tech note.
   - SFTP/export: ops runbook exists; will provide an abbreviated procedure and expected timelines.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Laura: propose Order Form language for the hosting commitment + an exception clause (by 2027-05-16 EOD).
- Monica: subprocessor list, SOC2 NDA template pointer, KMS brief, and ops export runbook (by 2027-05-17).
- Ben: coordinate a Friday 5/14 30-min triage (confirm availability).

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3_redline.pdf (high-level legal comments).

If LumenCare wants to limit scope to pilot (EU production only) and revisit broader geofencing after go-live, we can accept that as a commercial solution without perpetual additional fee. If they want a hard-coded SLA and contractual geofencing for all scenarios, we will need procurement/ops escalation.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[laura_bennett@redwood.com]
